title: Dónde publicar · resultados por proyecto
brief: Redesign the journal finder page reached from a project's "¿Dónde publicar este proyecto?" button, now served inside the project bank: show the selected project and its indexed, no-APC, free-to-read journals in the bank's visual identity, and make it easy to separate strong matches from noise.

artboards.title: Resultados por encaje
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and clear: strong matches first, technology journals collapsed, quartile filter built into the summary and a "No me sirve" action to hide noise; still a long list to scroll

artboards.title: Tabla comparativa
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest way to sort and compare journals side by side (estimated affinity, quartile, SJR, weeks, review, license); dense, best for teachers and research groups, weak on mobile

artboards.title: Ruta guiada por perfil
artboards.tradeoff: Best for students: picks 3 journals for the author's profile and adds a submission checklist; hides most of the 60 options behind a link

artboards.title: Afinidad estimada y filtros personalizados
artboards.tradeoff: Ranks journals by an explained 0–100 % fit score (topic, quartile vs project level, language, speed, region) and adds a custom filters panel with many variables and saved presets; the score is a heuristic, not an acceptance probability, and the panel adds density
